newsitem.title: USA: Polaris sees decline in some quarters' net.
newsitem.headline: Polaris sees decline in some quarters' net.

text.p: Polaris Industries Inc said Tuesday that full year 1997 sales and certain quarters' earnings are expected to decline from 1996 levels, but the company currently expects that full year 1997 net income will be another record.
The company Tuesday reported record sales and earnings for the year ended December 31, 1996.

For the year, net sales grew seven percent to $1.19 billion from $1.11 billion in 1995. Net income for the year totaled $62.3 million, up two percent from $60.8 million in 1995, while 1996 earnings per share totaled $2.24, up from $2.19 in 1995.
